tasks.label: prepare dev environment
tasks.command: [ -f .vscode/.env ] || for f in .vscode/.env.linux .vscode/.env.example; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then cp "$f" .vscode/.env && echo "created .vscode/.env from $f"; break; fi; done

osx.command: [ -f .vscode/.env ] || for f in .vscode/.env.mac .vscode/.env.example; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then cp "$f" .vscode/.env && echo "created .vscode/.env from $f"; break; fi; done

windows.command: if (-not (Test-Path .vscode/.env)) { foreach ($f in '.vscode/.env.windows', '.vscode/.env.example') { if (Test-Path $f) { Copy-Item $f .vscode/.env; Write-Output "created .vscode/.env from $f"; break } } }
